subject: Order form: invoice cadence / minimum commit / tax routing (Helio Health)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@heliohealth.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Order form: invoice cadence / minimum commit / tax routing (Helio Health)

Hi Patricia / Contracts team —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion I attached a clean copy of the Order Form (redwood_orderform_v2.pdf) with the fields we agreed in principle. Before we send to legal for signature we need to close out three commercial items so your procurement can attach the PO:

- Invoice cadence: you mentioned Helio prefers fewer invoices. Can we confirm whether you want an upfront invoice (for onboarding) + monthly invoices, or a single quarterly invoice?
- Minimum commit: Helio agreed to the 12‑month minimum but requested the commit be split across two entities. We need the billing entity and whether Redwood should issue a single invoice to the parent or separate invoices per entity.
- Taxes / VAT: procurement indicated Helio will provide a tax certificate but asked that Redwood remain responsible for VAT in some jurisdictions. We need to confirm invoicing party and tax responsibility.

Attached: redwood_orderform_v2.pdf (draft with commercial sheet).

Ask: Can you send the signed PO or confirm invoicing entity and preferred cadence by EOD Monday? If procurement needs our finance team looped, I’ve CC’d Jonas.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: redwood_orderform_v2.pdf (Order Form draft; commercial tab highlighted)

From: Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@heliohealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@heliohealth.com>, Michael Sims <michael.sims@heliohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Feb 2028 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cadence / minimum commit / tax routing (Helio Health)

Lauren — thanks for the note and the draft. Quick answers + a couple of asks from procurement/legal:

1) Invoice cadence: Helio prefers two invoices — an upfront invoice (activation) and then monthly invoices thereafter. We cannot do a single quarterly invoice for accounting reasons.
2) Minimum commit/entity split: Helio will pay from two entities (Helio US and Helio Solutions GmbH). Procurement requires invoices to be issued to the paying entity.
3) Taxes: Helio is requesting Redwood accept VAT responsibility for EU billings (Helio Solutions GmbH) unless Redwood can supply an EU tax registration number.

Attached: helio_po_4537.pdf (PO), helio_redline_comments.docx (legal redlines). Note the redline asks for net60 payment terms. Helio’s AP team will not process invoices with >60 day advance invoice dates.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Issue separate invoices to each paying entity
- Accept net60 for this deal (or propose an alternate)
- Provide EU tax registration evidence or confirm routing to a Redwood EU entity

Patricia Lopez
Head of Procurement, Helio Health
patricia.lopez@heliohealth.com

Attachment: helio_po_4537.pdf; helio_redline_comments.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@heliohealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Feb 2028 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cadence / minimum commit / tax routing (Helio Health)

Thanks Patricia — appreciate the quick turnaround and the PO. A few practical constraints from our side and a proposed path forward:

- Separate invoices per paying entity: we can issue separate invoices, but we need the legal entity names, billing addresses, and TAX IDs (for each). Please confirm those details.
- Net60: Redwood’s standard is net45 for enterprise. We can agree to net60 as a concession tied to the 12‑month minimum and the PO being submitted prior to the first invoice. If Helio requires net60 without the minimum we’d need to revisit pricing.
- VAT / EU: Redwood can accept responsibility only if we invoice from our EU subsidiary and have registration in the required jurisdiction. If Helio insists Redwood take VAT liability while Redwood invoices from the US entity, we will need to add a tax handling clause and possibly a small handling fee to the commercial sheet.

Proposed invoice cadence (flexible):
- Activation invoice: 30% of first year (issued on Effective Date)
- Monthly invoice: remaining 70% split across 11 monthly invoices, or
- Alternative: Activation 50% + 50% in 6 monthly installments (preferred for cashflow).

Next steps: Jonas — can you confirm whether finance can accept net60 with PO on file and whether we need language to limit the number of advance invoices >60 days? Also flag any collections or tax evidence requirements.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: proposal_invoice_schedule.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Feb 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cadence / minimum commit / tax routing (Helio Health)

Hi all — quick finance/legal input from my side. Quoting the redline helps make this concrete.

- Net terms: finance will accept net60 on a case‑by‑case basis provided we have a signed PO that covers the committed amount and an approved collections plan. Please note acceptance of net60 requires CFO approval for deals > $250k.
- Billing entity & VAT: we cannot accept VAT liability for EU invoices unless Redwood invoices from a registered EU entity. If Helio can accept invoices from Redwood EU entity (we have DE and IE registrants) then Redwood bears VAT and will supply VAT IDs on invoice. If Helio insists on US invoicing for the EU entity, Helio must handle VAT with their local filings.
- PO matching: Helio’s PO number must be present on the invoice for AP to process. If Helio routes to two paying entities we will issue two invoices referencing the same Order Form number.
- Advance invoices: we need a clause that prohibits customers from requesting invoices for periods further than 90 days in advance. Helio indicated they won't accept invoices > 60 days in advance — we can set 60 days as a hard limit for this deal.

I’ve attached suggested redline language for the Order Form commercial sheet to cover entity routing, VAT handling, and invoice acceptance criteria. If Helio can confirm the paying entities’ TAX IDs and the PO will be returned, we can finalize and route to DocuSign.

Jonas Weber
Finance Lead, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: suggested_orderform_redline.docx

From: Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@heliohealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@heliohealth@heliohealth.com>, Michael Sims <michael.sims@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Feb 2028 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cadence / minimum commit / tax routing (Helio Health)

Thanks all — attached is the redline from our legal and the PO (helio_po_4537.pdf). Helio is firm on net60 and requires the invoice to display Helio Solutions GmbH TAX ID for EU charges. AP will not process an invoice that references a US entity for EU consumption.

We can provide the TAX IDs — see below: 
- Helio US LLC (billing): EIN 12-3456789
- Helio Solutions GmbH (EU billing): DE 987654321

Procurement note: Helio cannot accept an activation invoice dated earlier than 60 days in advance of the service start date.

Please confirm Redwood’s invoicing entity and final schedule so we can return signed PO quickly.

Patricia

Attachment: helio_po_4537.pdf; helio_redline_comments.docx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@heliohealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Feb 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cadence / minimum commit / tax routing (Helio Health)

Patricia — thanks for the TAX IDs and the PO. Summary and proposed final path (happy to adjust if anyone objects):

1) Billing entities / VAT: Redwood will invoice Helio US LLC for US spend and Redwood GmbH (our DE entity) for EU spend. Redwood will provide the DE VAT ID on EU invoices so Redwood accepts VAT for EU‑invoiced amounts. Please confirm that Helio Solutions GmbH will accept invoices from Redwood GmbH.

2) Invoice cadence / activation invoice: Activation invoice = 30% of first year, issued on Effective Date; remaining 70% to be invoiced monthly across months 2–12 (11 monthly invoices). This meets Helio’s request for smaller monthly invoices rather than a single quarterly invoice. We can alternatively do 50/6 if Helio prefers — let us know.

3) Net terms: Redwood agrees to net60 for this deal subject to: (a) signed PO on file covering committed amount, and (b) CFO final signoff (Ben will coordinate). Jonas: please confirm CFO approval; if granted, we’ll update the Order Form net terms to net60.

4) Advance invoices cutoff: For this agreement we will NOT issue invoices dated earlier than 60 days before service date (matches Helio procurement rule).

5) PO and invoice matching: PO# 4537 will be included on every invoice. Please confirm billing addresses for each entity for the invoice header (we have the TAX IDs).

Next steps / action items:
- Patricia: confirm acceptance of Redwood GmbH as EU invoicing entity and provide formal signing authority for the PO (who will sign).
- Jonas: escalate to CFO for net60 approval and confirm whether any pricing adjustment is required.
- Ben: prepare updated Order Form with the agreed commercial sheet and send to DocuSign link (I will coordinate signatures).

If we can get confirmation today we’ll finalize and route to DocuSign by EOD.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
